description: A strategic location on one of the country's main freight corridors, with direct connections to Monterrey, Nuevo Laredo, and the United States.

item1.title: Highway access
item1.text: Fronting the Monterrey-Nuevo Laredo Highway, with access via Av. Raúl Hinojosa Martínez.

item2.title: Logistics corridor
item2.text: Monterrey-Nuevo Laredo, the main overland freight route to the United States.

item4.title: 30 km from the metropolitan area
item4.text: Connection to the center of the Monterrey Metropolitan Area.

item5.title: Immediate neighbors
item5.text: Hussmann · VYNMSA North · CPA ADN · Prosperity · Pocket Park · Joyas · Litos.
